options.text: Salt is the solute and water is the solvent.
Salt is the solvent and water is the solute.
Water stops being the solvent once more salt than water is present.
Salt is the solute only while undissolved salt grains can still be seen.

stem:
Yash dissolves a large amount of common salt in a small amount of water to make strong brine.

Which claim names the solute and the solvent correctly?

teacher.key_rationale: In a solid-in-liquid solution, the solid is the solute and the liquid is the solvent, even when a large amount of salt dissolves in a small amount of water and grains are no longer visible.
